name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Initialization & Training Schedule
definition: Initialization and training schedule for the 3D Gaussian Splatting model in SGD, using LiDAR point clouds and pseudo-view guidance.
summary: This method stabilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting in sparse scenes by initializing Gaussians from LiDAR data and regularizing training via pseudo-view guidance, differing from standard pipelines.
